findings.title: Decorators are checked against the decorated function's own bindings
findings.evidence: A parameterized @skip regression failed before and passed after decorator evaluation moved to the enclosing scope.

findings.title: A comprehension nested directly in another comprehension leaks its loop variable into the function scope
findings.evidence: A nested-comprehension skip regression failed before and passed after comprehension-root collection was fixed.

notes: Direct fresh-context review on the read-only snapshot was used after repeated CLI health-check failures. The returned JSON was extracted from Markdown fencing without changing its content. The two P3 findings were fixed; no other finding was reported.
